title: Rectangle Class
statement:
Build a `Rectangle` class. Each rectangle object stores its own `width` and `height` and has two methods: `area()`, which returns width times height, and `perimeter()`, which returns the distance around the rectangle.

The input is one line with two whole numbers, the width and the height, separated by a space. Either one can be 0. Create a rectangle from them, then print its area on the first line and its perimeter on the second.

Input:

```text
3 4
```

Expected output:

```text
12
14
```
hints: The constructor runs once when the object is made. Save both numbers on the object there so the methods can read them later.
The perimeter adds up all four sides: two widths and two heights.
